patch.value: GH-763: merge-decision receipt persists shell-quoted item_path that cannot resolve

The Git merge driver double-quotes %P even though Git already shell-quotes that placeholder, so conflict receipts store literal quote characters around item_path. The merge decision remains durable but its repair target cannot be opened programmatically; older clone-local driver config also survives package upgrades.

Generated merge-driver configuration passes %P exactly once without preserving Git shell quotes; the runtime defensively normalizes one legacy shell-quote pair; merge report and validate diagnose stale clone-local driver configuration; Linux, macOS, Windows, packed-consumer, and two-branch merge tests prove receipt paths resolve; existing receipt data remains readable.
Every merge-decision receipt stores a repository-relative item_path that resolves directly, including in clones whose merge driver was installed by an older pm version.
Receipts store values such as '.agents/pm/tasks/pm-id.toon' with the single quote characters included, so the recorded path does not exist.
